bot_filter_change: verdict.ESCALATE is now {js_shell, suspect}. A bot_filter or js_check verdict (read, R2 alternate, or captured text) is an opted_out stop with reasons prefixed 'bot_filter:' / 'js_check:' that stops the whole site (registrable domain) for the run; no R2/R3, next_step None. ingest refuses and records as the same site stop any capture that went through a check: ux-page-read challenge markers (interactive -> human_check, otherwise js_check), waited_ms > 0 (js_check:capture:waited_ms:N), or captured text whose verdict is js_check/bot_filter/human_check; no capture is accepted on a stopped site. A check served instead of robots.txt stops the site the same way (unavailable_bot_filtered = disallow all).
